summary.text: Joe Brothers is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 48A in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Jim Nash.
A banking executive, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running for office for the first time.

paragraphs.text: Joe Brothers' career experience includes working as a banking executive.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a bank vice president who has experience preventing fraud.
Brothers said his campaign messages are making Minnesota more affordable to live in, preventing fraud and holding those responsible accountable, and making the state safer for families.
His listed policy interests include housing affordability, education and career development, disability services, small businesses and farmers, and the economy and jobs.
Ballotpedia lists Education Minnesota among his endorsements.
